name: Maggie Di
bio:
Hello, welcome to my little corner of the internet! I'm Maggie, a student at the University of British Columbia studying Environment & Sustainability.

Outside the classroom, I create content and have worked in public-facing roles where clear communication, organization, and empathy matter. I'm especially interested in sustainability, community impact, and thoughtful storytelling.

This site is a simple place to share what I'm learning, what I've worked on, and a few projects that are easy to update over time. Feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions or want to collaborate on a project!

workExperience.description: Supported travelers in a fast-paced airport environment, answered questions clearly, and helped keep day-to-day service running smoothly.
Worked in a high-responsibility public service role that required professionalism, attention to detail, and confident communication with travelers.
Planned and ran community programming, coordinated schedules and logistics, and helped create welcoming events for children and families.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Environment & Sustainability
Bachelor of Sciences in Geographical Information Systems

volunteering.description: Volunteered at A Loving Spoonful, a food bank in Vancouver, to help with food distribution and community outreach.
Managed the UBC Student Environment Centre's social media accounts and created content for the organization.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: A monorepo personal site built with React, TypeScript, Express, and Tailwind CSS. It pulls profile content from an API and falls back gracefully when the backend is unavailable.

projects.title: Study Cafe Locator
projects.description: A website that allows users to find study cafes near them. It uses the Google Maps API to get the coordinates of the cafes and then uses the City of Vancouver Open Data Portal to get the name and address of the cafes.

projects.title: Richmond Vancouver International Airport Flood Simulation
projects.description: A simulation of the flood that occurred at the Richmond Vancouver International Airport in 2019. It uses the City of Richmond Open Data Portal to get the coordinates of the airport and then uses the Google Maps API to get the coordinates of the flood.

projects.title: AI Closet Planner
projects.description: A website that allows users to plan their closet using AI. It uses the OpenAI API to generate a closet plan based on the user's input.
